why: The authentic Better Auth/broker/registered participant fixture enrolls and spawns a real PTY child. Its shipped cotal_run handler uses only the child's own native bearerCmd and manager pin.
The child imports the built public connector package, so mutant build and exact restored build/native execution are mandatory. No Manager/auth policy is mutated.
The same native fixture preserves all U4 persona cells, exercises released-run resume, and refuses missing child/current parent run, stale UID and wrong instance.
